source_snapshot.procedure: Generic setup says clear logs; open Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor reading and threshold are human readable and match specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES passes both comma-separated labels as one quoted sensor name, truncates fallback inventory, exposes credentials and does not prove distinct board-probe source, PSU bay/FRU/feed mapping or per-sensor UI/spec compliance.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION requires separate PSU1/PSU2 records, physical/PMBus source and slot mapping, inventory/redundancy context and complete UI/spec evidence.

old_problem: The two source labels were converted into one likely invalid sensor operand. Neither result was independently bound to its physical PSU bay, installed FRU and actual motherboard-probe versus PSU-internal source, so swapped labels, an absent PSU, stale data or PMBus telemetry could be falsely accepted as both inlet sensors.
disposition_reason: The source clearly requires two passive sensor checks. Resolve and collect PSU1_IN and PSU2_IN independently, map each to the chassis bay, installed PSU inventory, AC feed and real sensing source, then compare each complete OOB/two-UI record against its own population-aware specification. Exact bay/source mapping and values are Project parameters; no PSU service or stimulus is required.
decision_basis: XLSX row 877, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, internal Script reference, selection manifest and historical record were directly reviewed.
A quoted comma-separated operand is not evidence for two records; each sensor needs an independent identity, query status and evidence chain.
The `MB` label does not by itself prove a motherboard probe or equivalence to a PSU-internal PMBus channel; bay/FRU/source mapping is required.
ED-13 controls population-aware N/A, ED-15 requires per-bay acceptance, ED-17 preserves logs, and ED-20 preserves both named sensors independently.

test_case.test_name: Verify TEMP_MB_PSU1_IN and TEMP_MB_PSU2_IN independently by physical bay, FRU and sensing source
test_case.purpose: Verify the two motherboard PSU-inlet temperature records are individually human readable in Dashboard and Server Health, correctly mapped to PSU bay 1 and bay 2 and their actual sensing paths, and independently meet applicable value, units, health, threshold/hysteresis and freshness requirements under the recorded passive power and airflow state.
required_package: Exact chassis/board/BMC/BIOS configuration, physical PSU bay numbering, AC-feed topology, redundancy mode and installed PSU PN/serial/FRU/firmware inventory
For each label, documented motherboard-probe or PSU PMBus/I2C/controller/address/channel source and physical inlet location
Separate stable SDR/API name/number/type/entity/instance and Dashboard/Server Health row for PSU1_IN and PSU2_IN
Per-sensor units/scaling, approved range or reference delta, threshold capability/values/hysteresis, health, freshness and absent-module behavior
Recorded system power/load, fan mode/speeds, inlet/airflow state, timing and approved tolerance/update-lag rules
Validated protected OOB/API/browser clients and pinned immutable reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or approved manual read-only method
test_case.test_command: Do not clear logs, remove/reseat a PSU, disable a feed, change redundancy/power cap, add load, obstruct airflow or write thresholds. Establish a two-row bay/FRU/feed/source expectation matrix from inventory and platform documentation. Enumerate the complete repository and resolve TEMP_MB_PSU1_IN and TEMP_MB_PSU2_IN separately; never pass the comma-separated pair as one identifier. Review the Script before use. Capture each independent command status, stable identity, value, units, capability/threshold/hysteresis, health and timestamp plus its matching Dashboard and Server Health rows. Compare each with its per-bay specification under recorded passive power/load/fan/airflow state, using PMBus/reference data only when its different source is explicit. Stop without retry on missing, duplicate, swapped, stale or divergent identity.
test_case.expected_result: Two distinct stable records and their UI rows map to the correct physical PSU bays, installed FRUs and documented sensing sources. Each applicable sensor independently matches its value/unit/threshold/status/freshness specification in the recorded passive state. An absent module follows only the approved population rule; one bay or PSU-internal telemetry never substitutes for the other motherboard inlet, and no state is mutated.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires inventory/source/bay proof and separate complete OOB/two-UI/spec agreement for both applicable sensors with an engineer verdict. One comma operand, one bay, label-only matching, similar values, truncated output or unqualified PMBus substitution cannot pass. Missing/swapped/duplicate/stale identity, unjustified N/A, out-of-tolerance value or required threshold/status mismatch is FAIL. Missing bay/source/spec/reviewed method is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS; redundancy failover and hot-swap are not covered.
safety_gate: Do not clear SEL/system logs; power, PSU, PMBus and thermal history is relevant context.
Do not query the comma-separated pair as one name; preserve two independent results and statuses.
Do not infer PSU presence, bay or motherboard/PMBus source from labels or values; bind to physical inventory.
Do not service a PSU/feed, change redundancy/power/load/fan/airflow or write thresholds.
Use population and threshold capability rules; an empty bay or unsupported field is N/A only with specification proof.
Do not truncate output, expose credentials or run an unreviewed Script; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Chassis/board/BMC/BIOS, physical bay numbering, AC feeds, redundancy state and installed PSU PN/serial/FRU/firmware inventory
Two separate complete raw identities, sensing-source paths, values, units, threshold capabilities/values, health and timestamps
Separate Dashboard and Server Health evidence for each bay
Per-bay specification plus passive power/load/fan/airflow state and approved tolerance/update-lag comparison
Absent/missing/duplicate/swapped/stale and PMBus-versus-board-source disposition with pinned Script or alternate-method audit
No-clear/no-write/no-service/no-stress/no-retry proof, final redundancy/BMC health and per-bay engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is expected. On identity, source or bay ambiguity, stale/divergent values or unexpected PSU/BMC health change, stop and preserve both sensors' first evidence plus inventory/feed state. Use approved read-only PSU/BMC diagnostics; do not reseat/remove a PSU or alter a feed to force evidence. Any independently authorized change is restored only by the platform owner.

source_conflict.reason: Items clearly list two motherboard PSU-inlet sensors and Procedure/Criteria consistently require passive UI/spec verification. The combined command interpretation is defective, not the source purpose.

blocked.reason: The two-target passive purpose is clear. Bay, FRU, source and acceptance mappings are supplyable Project inputs.
